title: When is Cyber Monday 2026? Here’s everything you need to know
summary: Cyber Monday 2026 falls on November 30. Here’s what to expect, how to prepare, and how to save big on the year’s final major deal event.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- Cyber Monday 2026 falls on November 30—the Monday after Black Friday.


- Cyber Monday is historically one of the best times to find deals on electronics and tech, but customers can expect savings across categories like beauty, fashion, toys, and home.


- Check back soon for more information, and be sure to sign up for Prime ahead of the holiday season.


---


The holiday shopping season’s final big deal event is almost here.


[Cyber Monday 2026](https://www.aboutamazon.com/amazon-cyber-monday-deals) falls on November 30, and it’s one of the best chances to score deep discounts before the holidays arrive.


[How to use Alexa for Shopping to compare products, check price history, auto-buy items at target prices, and more](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-use-amazon-shopping-ai-assistant)


From price tracking to automated purchases to new release alerts, here’s how to get the most out of Amazon’s AI shopping assistant.


Whether you’re finishing up your gift list, treating yourself to something you’ve had your eye on, or hunting for that one last deal, Cyber Monday is the moment to make it happen. Here’s everything you need to know about Cyber Monday 2026 on Amazon—including when it is, what to expect, and how to save.


## What is Cyber Monday?


Cyber Monday is an annual shopping event that takes place the Monday after Thanksgiving. Originally known for online-exclusive deals on electronics and tech, Cyber Monday has grown into one of the biggest deal events of the year, with savings across virtually every product category. On Amazon, customers can expect deals on electronics, beauty, fashion, toys, home essentials, and more.


## When is Cyber Monday 2026?


Cyber Monday 2026 falls on November 30. It always takes place the Monday after Black Friday—which is November 27 this year.


## What kinds of Cyber Monday deals can I expect to see on Amazon?


Cyber Monday has historically been one of the best times to find deals on electronics and tech—and this year is no exception. But the savings go well beyond tech: Customers can expect deals across popular categories like beauty, fashion, toys, and home.


Customers can shop early deals in the


[Holiday Shop](https://www.amazon.com/holidayshop) now. Check back soon for more details on specific Cyber Monday deals—and be sure to


[sign up for Prime](https://www.amazon.com/prime) ahead of the event.


## How can I make sure I don’t miss out on Cyber Monday deals?


Start by browsing Amazon’s


[Deals page](https://www.amazon.com/deals) for early savings. You can also prepare for Cyber Monday by adding items to your lists, cart, or Save for Later. With enhanced Alexa+ deal tracking, you can get instant notifications when watched items go on sale—so you're ready to act the moment prices drop.


[8 visual search features that help you quickly find what you’re looking for on Amazon](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/visual-search-shopping-features)


New, intuitive features surface visual suggestions to ensure you have faster and more precise product searches.


## How can AI shopping features help you save during Cyber Monday?


Looking for the best deal doesn’t have to mean hours of scrolling.


[Alexa for Shopping](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/alexa-for-shopping-ai-assistant) —Amazon’s AI shopping assistant—can do the deal hunting for you, surfacing relevant deals, tracking prices, and keeping you informed so you never miss a savings opportunity. Here are a few ways it can help:


- Track deals and price drops:


Ask Alexa for Shopping to monitor items you’re eyeing. You can even set up


[auto-buy](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-use-amazon-shopping-ai-assistant) to complete the purchase automatically when the price hits your target.


- Check up to a year of price history:


Tap “


[Price History](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-check-amazon-price-history) ” on any product page, or ask Alexa for Shopping, to view up to 365 days of pricing data—so you can feel confident you’re getting a great deal.


- Build and manage holiday lists with your voice:


Create


[Wish Lists](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-wish-list) , organize a registry, or move items between lists—all by asking Alexa for Shopping.


## Where can I find gift ideas and inspiration?


Not sure what to get? Browse gift guides within Amazon’s


[Holiday Shop](https://www.amazon.com/holidayshop) , where you’ll find curated guides organized by recipient, price point, and interest, and the annual


[Top 100+ Toys list](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/best-gifts-kids-amazon-toys-we-love-list-2026) —all in one place.


You can also support small businesses while you shop. More than 60% of sales in Amazon’s store come from


[independent sellers](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/small-business/amazon-2025-small-business-empowerment-report) , most of which are small and medium-sized businesses. Browse the


[small business storefront](https://www.amazon.com/smallbusiness) to discover unique gifts.


[When is Black Friday 2026? Here’s everything you need to know](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/when-is-amazon-black-friday-faq)


Black Friday 2026 falls on November 27. Here’s what to expect, how to prepare, and how to save.


## How do I join Prime before Cyber Monday 2026?


If you want to take advantage of the many


[benefits of a Prime membership](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/prime-membership-shopping-benefits) during the holiday season and beyond, now’s a great time to sign up for savings, convenience, and entertainment all in one membership.


Anyone can


[join Prime](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-sign-up-for-a-prime-membership) for $14.99 per month or $139 per year, or start a


[free 30-day trial](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-free-trial) if eligible.


Amazon also offers discounted membership options providing the same benefits at only 50% of the cost. Young adults (ages 18–24) and college students can try


[Prime for Young Adults](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-for-young-adults) with a six-month free trial, then pay only $7.49 per month, or $69 per year. Qualifying government-assistance recipients and income-verified customers can try


[Prime Access](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-access-discounted-membership) for 30 days before paying $6.99 per month.


For more information about Prime, including discounted memberships, visit


[Prime](https://www.aboutamazon.com/what-we-do/prime) . And remember to check back soon for more details on Cyber Monday 2026 deals on Amazon.
